scope: A guided ordinary factory task inside the existing Production view; reuse existing physical game services and controls.
player_outcome: Know the next useful step from an empty field to actual manufactured Building Materials and rifle ammunition, with workforce and missing-input causes linked to existing actions.

interfaces.projection: FactoryPlan.view(simulation) returns detached workers, facilities, steps, next_action and complete facts without changing the model.
interfaces.panel: FactoryPlanPanel.bind(session) subscribes to current committed-state/replacement events and exposes its current detached view; action_requested(action) delegates navigation to the existing rear controller.
interfaces.next_action: A detached dictionary with panel, building_kind, facility_id, label and reason; navigation drafts never purchase, place or manufacture automatically. Optional focus names an existing field; revisiting the already selected facility preserves unsubmitted drafts.
interfaces.complete: Only true when actual Completed R26 and R02 batches exist in current authoritative production history. Starting M11, unrelated output or Cancelled batches do not establish completion.

ownership.authoritative: Existing receiving, rear staffing, construction, production and ledger owners.
ownership.projection: Narrow read-only facts; no copied authoritative inventory or persistent completion flags.
ownership.presentation: One scene-owned panel, existing UIKit, retained selection and current-session signal subscriptions.
ownership.integration: Current lead; worker cannot publish or change gameplay defaults.

scheduling: Coalesce a finite signal burst into one deferred visible refresh. No new process/physics callback, timer, time_advanced subscription, repeated idle scan or full-world export. Elapsed work animation remains in existing production controls.
lifecycle: A hidden panel retains dirty state without reading the model; showing it reads fresh state. Replacement resolves the current model at refresh time. Rebinding and exit disconnect old subscriptions; obsolete deferred work cannot write a departed session.
principles: Single authoritative owner and command/query separation
Reuse real commands rather than synthetic progress or resource grants
failure_paths: Facility missing, building, cancelled or destroyed
Missing ingredients or pending physical transport
Paused, stopped, inaccessible or output-blocked production
An output stock minimum is already covered by starting, existing or valid committed stock; that does not establish newly completed manufacture.
unchanged_rules: Starting stock, prices, recipes, capacities, timings, physical output, consumption and military AI remain unchanged.
verification_limit: A brief direct check of this new projection, panel lifecycle and physical factory completion is not full-game, native-input or FPS acceptance.
